shots.prompt: {moss} shuffles down a street with his head bent low over his cupped hands and bonks his head on a lamppost. Static medium shot. Flat grey light.
{moss} gasps and points at a huge colourful mural of a smiling sun painted on a brick wall. Static wide shot. Bright saturated colours.
{moss} waves at a fluffy orange cat on a windowsill, and the cat slowly blinks back. Static medium shot. Warm sunlight.
{moss} and his friends chop vegetables and stir bubbling pots in a crowded little kitchen, laughing. The camera circles slowly. Warm golden light.
{moss} dances in the middle of the kitchen, spinning a friend around. The camera circles. Bright warm party light.
{moss} climbs a chunky tree and settles among the leaves with a finger on his lips. The camera tilts up with him. Dappled sunlight.
{moss} walks toward the camera on a country path, his raincoat open over a cream t-shirt, and gives a big thumbs up and a wink. The camera tracks backward. Bright morning sun.
{moss} laughs as a goat leans over a fence and nibbles his yellow pom-pom. Static medium shot. Bright afternoon light.
